name: BACH_0221
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (93%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, model agreement, and high reliability support routine tier 4 review (ER stain drafted).

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 93%, Invasive 5%, Benign 2%, Normal 1% [F1] | Strong InSitu, low invasive risk |
| Conformal set | InSitu only (alpha 10%; 90% dataset coverage) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 100% OOD percentile, 12/12 regions kept [F6] | Reliable input despite atypical OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 InSitu (80%) [F5]; 1 Invasive (BACH_0166, 75%) | Mostly InSitu, one invasive neighbor |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 0, 1, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.48 contribution) lowers invasive score [F2] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.43 contribution) slightly raises invasive score [F3] · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 4, 8) · context · Above-typical score (-0.42 contribution); differs from invasive case BACH_0166 [F4] · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 3) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.39 contribution), 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Nuclear size and shape variation** (regions 3, 8, 9) · context · 100th-percentile size/shape CV [F8] [F9]; 0th-percentile area 44 µm² [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive score above random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), and necrosis (3/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Focal stromal invasion exists in highest-risk regions 8 (24% risk), 9 (15% risk), or 3 (9% risk).
- Morphology matches invasive neighbor BACH_0166 (75% similarity), which differs most in lymphocytes and marked nuclear pleomorphism.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9, 3**: Inspect highest-risk regions (24%, 15%, 9%) and sampled nuclei for focal stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 11**: Confirm atypical cells remain confined within ducts and review the drafted ER stain.
3. **Regions 4, 5, 8, 10**: Check TILs and validated nuclear pleomorphism (18/20) distinguishing invasive contrast case BACH_0166.

found: The CONCH–MUSK row names InSitu, but agreement.conch_musk_same_top only says the two models agree with each other; the JSON does not say which class they chose.
OOD percentile 1 means this image is farther from the calibration images than 100% of them (atypical), not 'typical'.
